title: Purple Style Labs IPO Details
intro:
Purple Style Labs IPO is a book build issue of ₹680.00 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 1.18 crore shares of ₹680.00 crore.

Purple Style Labs IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 31, 2026 and will close on Sep 2, 2026. The allotment for the Purple Style Labs IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 3, 2026. Purple Style Labs IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 7, 2026.

Purple Style Labs IPO is set issue price band at ₹546 to ₹575 per share. The lot size for an application is 26 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,950 (26 shares) (based on upper price).

Axis Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Purple Style Labs IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in August 2015, Purple Style Labs Limited is a multi-brand luxury omni-channel fashion platform operating under Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop (PPUS), offering a curated portfolio of luxury fashion products across womenswear, menswear, jewellery, accessories and kidswear, with a focus on wedding and occasion wear. The Company sources products from 1,109 active designer brands as of March 31, 2026, including Seema Gujral, Anushree Reddy, Amit Aggarwal and Rohit Gandhi & Rahul Khanna.

The Company operates through an omni-channel business model comprising Experience Centers, its website, mobile application, telephonic and digital sales channels, events and exhibitions. As of March 31, 2026, it had 14 Experience Centers globally, including 12 in India and one each in London and New York. During Fiscal 2024–2026, the Company served more than 200,000 unique customers, while in Fiscal 2026 it recorded ₹7,215.62 million in Total PPUS GMV and an average order value of ₹75,504.88.

The Company has established a strong international presence, serving customers across India, the US, UK, Middle East, Australia and other markets. Its platform provides customers access to curated Indian luxury fashion while enabling designer brands to reach a wider domestic and global customer base without establishing their own retail and distribution networks. The Company is led by Abhishek Agarwal, Promoter, Whole-Time Director and CEO, supported by an experienced management team and Board with expertise across retail, sales, marketing, product management, consultancy and finance. As of March 31, 2026, the Company had 1,266 permanent employees.
strengths: Multi-brand omni-channel luxury platform with a wide portfolio of products and strong designer relationships.
Omni-channel business model focused on operational efficiency.
Strong customer retention and network effects supporting monetization.

faqs.question: How to apply in Purple Style Labs IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Purple Style Labs IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Purple Style Labs IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Purple Style Labs IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Purple Style Labs IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Purple Style Labs IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Purple Style Labs IPO opens on Mon, Aug 31, 2026 and closes on Wed, Sep 2, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Purple Style Labs IPO?
faqs.answer: Purple Style Labs IPO lot size is 26 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,950 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Purple Style Labs IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Purple Style Labs IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Purple Style Labs IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Purple Style Labs IPO will be done on Thursday, September 3, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Sep 4, 2026 . Check the Purple Style Labs IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Purple Style Labs IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Purple Style Labs IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Sep 7, 2026 .
